name: Postmark
tagline: Transactional email API focused on reliable delivery.
shortDescription: Postmark provides email sending, templates, inbound parsing, suppressions, message streams, and webhooks.
agentSummary: Agents can send transactional email and inspect delivery events with a simpler operational model than broad marketing suites.
bestFor: Transactional email, templates, inbound processing, and delivery troubleshooting.
cautionNotes: Key limitations: Outbound email still requires domain authentication, test sends, and approval for customer-facing content. Outbound messages, SMS, email deliverability, consent, unsubscribe behavior, private chats, and customer-facing replies need approval, throttling, and audit logs. API automation needs client-side throttling, idempotency where supported, pagination limits, retries, and audit logging. Account setup or elevated access may require vendor, admin, or compliance approval before an agent can operate independently.
pricingSummary: Public monthly pricing by email volume.
authModel: Server API tokens, account API tokens, webhooks, and domain verification.
browserSupport: Dashboard supports streams, templates, logs, and suppressions.

capabilities.detail: Developer API covers sending, templates, inbound, suppressions, message streams, and webhooks.
Docs include API reference, webhooks, and delivery concepts.
Pricing is public by monthly volume.
Dashboard supports streams, templates, logs, and suppressions.
